image_description: A coastal landscape featuring a steep, rugged cliff face composed of light-colored stratified rock dropping into the ocean. The top of the cliff is covered in green grass and vegetation, with a small structure or group of people visible on the ridge. The base of the cliff meets dark blue water with white foam from waves crashing against the rocks.
